messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: rmr on MapR
parts:
Hi,
it's hard to tell what's going on but it's easy to see where, if you do a debug(rmr:::list.to.data.frame) and source rmr-Ex.R which is under the pkg.Rcheck subtree created by the check command it should stop right before the problem happens and you can then debug more in depth. If you can give me a remote login on a mapR/RHadoop cluster I am happy to look into it myself. Actually, this is likely to happen even in standalone mode if mapR has such a thing, just an educated guess.


Antonio
